proof_spans.label: the author's own proof environment immediately following the proposition: endow the connected component of the identity with its canonical scheme structure; the inversion automorphism fixes it, and geometric connectedness makes G^0 x_k G^0 connected, so multiplication lands in G^0 set-theoretically and factors through the closed immersion by the flat-closed-immersion lemma, making G^0 a closed subgroup scheme; irreducibility, geometric irreducibility, and quasi-compactness follow from three in-chapter lemmas (source lines 1241-1266)
